import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Flow {
        static class Edge {
            int u, v;
            long f, c;
            Edge(int u, int v, long f, long c) {
                this.u = u;
                this.v = v;
                this.f = f;
                this.c = c;
            }
        }
        int src, sink;
        ArrayList<Edge> e = new ArrayList<>();
        ArrayList<Integer>[] adj;
        int[] d, seen, cur;
        final int MAX_SIZE = 7100;
        final long INF = 1000000000L;

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Flow() {
            adj = new ArrayList[MAX_SIZE];
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SIZE; i++) adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            d = new int[MAX_SIZE];
            seen = new int[MAX_SIZE];
            cur = new int[MAX_SIZE];
        }

        void init() {
            e.clear();
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SIZE; i++) adj[i].clear();
        }

        void add(int u, int v, long cap) {
            e.add(new Edge(u, v, 0, cap));
            e.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0));
            adj[u].add(e.size() - 2);
            adj[v].add(e.size() - 1);
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(seen, 0);
            Arrays.fill(d, 0);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(src);
            seen[src] = 1;
            d[src] = 0;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int x = q.poll();
                for (int id : adj[x]) {
                    Edge ed = e.get(id);
                    if (seen[ed.v] == 0 && ed.c > ed.f) {
                        d[ed.v] = d[x] + 1;
                        q.add(ed.v);
                        seen[ed.v] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
            return seen[sink] != 0;
        }

        long dfs(int x, long flow) {
            if (x == sink || flow == 0) return flow;
            long pushed = 0, add;
            for (int i = cur[x]; i < adj[x].size(); i++) {
                cur[x] = i;
                Edge ed = e.get(adj[x].get(i));
                if (d[x] + 1 == d[ed.v]) {
                    long minf = Math.min(flow, ed.c - ed.f);
                    add = dfs(ed.v, minf);
                    if (add > 0) {
                        ed.f += add;
                        e.get(adj[x].get(i) ^ 1).f -= add;
                        pushed += add;
                        flow -= add;
                        if (flow == 0) break;
                    }
                }
            }
            return pushed;
        }

        long dinic() {
            long flow = 0;
            while (bfs()) {
                Arrays.fill(cur, 0);
                flow += dfs(src, INF);
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static Flow mf = new Flow();
    static char[][] g1 = new char[14][14];
    static char[][] g2 = new char[14][14];
    static boolean[][] vis = new boolean[14][14];
    static int[][] dist = new int[14][14];
    static int n;
    static int[] tgt;

    static void BFS(int sx, int sy) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 14; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < 14; j++)
                dist[i][j] = 111;
        dist[sx][sy] = 0;
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy, 0});
        int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1};
        int[] dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = q.poll();
            int cx = p[0], cy = p[1];
            if (vis[cx][cy]) continue;
            vis[cx][cy] = true;
            dist[cx][cy] = p[2];
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = cx + dx[i], ny = cy + dy[i];
                if (nx < 1 || nx > n || ny < 1 || ny > n || vis[nx][ny] || g1[nx][ny] == 'Y') continue;
                q.add(new int[]{nx, ny, p[2] + 1});
            }
        }
    }

    static int idx(int l, int x, int y) {
        return l * n * n + (x - 1) * n + y;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        n = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String s = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                g1[i][j] = s.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String s = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                g2[i][j] = s.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }

        mf.src = 0;
        mf.sink = 7100 - 2;
        int sx = 0, sy = 0;
        outer:
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (g1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    sx = i;
                    sy = j;
                    break outer;
                }
            }
        }

        int totalCells = n * n;
        tgt = new int[totalCells + 2];
        for (int i = 1; i <= totalCells; i++) {
            tgt[i] = 7100 - 3 - (totalCells - i);
        }

        BFS(sx, sy);

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (g1[i][j] >= '0' && g1[i][j] <= '9')
                    mf.add(mf.src, idx(0, i, j), g1[i][j] - '0');
                if (g2[i][j] >= '0' && g2[i][j] <= '9')
                    mf.add(tgt[idx(0, i, j)], mf.sink, g2[i][j] - '0');
                mf.add(idx(0, i, j), tgt[idx(0, i, j)], mf.INF);
            }
        }

        int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1};
        int[] dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};
        for (int i = 1; i <= t; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                    if (g1[j][k] == 'Y' || g1[j][k] == 'Z') continue;
                    for (int l = 0; l < 4; l++) {
                        int tx = dx[l] + j, ty = dy[l] + k;
                        if (tx >= 1 && tx <= n && ty >= 1 && ty <= n && g1[tx][ty] != 'Y' && g1[tx][ty] != 'Z') {
                            if (dist[j][k] >= i && dist[tx][ty] >= i && g1[j][k] != 'Y' && g1[j][k] != 'Z') {
                                mf.add(idx(i - 1, tx, ty), idx(i, j, k), mf.INF);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    mf.add(idx(i, j, k), tgt[idx(0, j, k)], mf.INF);
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(mf.dinic());
        sc.close();
    }
}
